node.title: Re: Privilege reduction with start_server / plackup
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Does it have to be [mod://Twiggy]? [mod://Starman] supports --user and --group options... [https://bitbucket.org/haukex/hgpstools/src/5997e5ca4dd61fe6f/dex/dex_starman.pl#lines-44|here] is a script I wrote that additionally uses [mod://Daemon::Control] to set up Starman as a daemon.
